summary: Largest startup ecosystem in Oceania, centred on Sydney and Melbourne with growing Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide hubs. Strong in SaaS, fintech, healthtech and deep tech; global outcomes include Atlassian, Canva, Afterpay and Airwallex.
startup_visa: National Innovation Visa (subclass 858, permanent, invitation-only via EOI; covers exceptional entrepreneurs), https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing/national-innovation-visa-858
company_setup: Proprietary limited company (Pty Ltd) registered online with ASIC in about a day (fee about A$600). Needs at least one director ordinarily resident in Australia, so foreigners usually appoint a local director.

grants.name: Export Market Development Grants (EMDG)
grants.amount: A$20k-80k matched per year across Tiers 1-3
grants.eligibility: SMEs with turnover under A$20m spending at least A$20k on eligible export marketing
grants.deadline: Round 4 closed; next round TBA after 2026 review

grants.name: R&D Tax Incentive (refundable offset)
grants.amount: Refundable offset = company tax rate + 18.5% premium (43.5% for most small companies)
grants.eligibility: Companies with aggregated turnover under A$20m doing eligible R&D; register within 10 months of year end
grants.deadline: annual: register within 10 months of FY end (2027-04-30 for FY2025-26)

grants.name: CSIRO Kick-Start
grants.amount: A$20k-60k matched funding for research with CSIRO
grants.eligibility: Turnover and opex under A$10m or trading under 3 years; GST registered; ACN

grants.name: Business Research and Innovation Initiative (BRII)
grants.amount: Feasibility up to A$100k; proof-of-concept up to A$1m by invitation
grants.eligibility: SMEs with turnover under A$20m solving a government challenge
grants.deadline: no rounds open; challenge rounds announced ad hoc

grants.name: Industry Growth Program (IGP)
grants.amount: Early-stage commercialisation A$50k-250k; commercialisation and growth A$100k-5m
grants.eligibility: Innovative SMEs in National Reconstruction Fund priority areas; must complete IGP Advisory Service first

grants.name: Cooperative Research Centres Projects (CRC-P) Grants
grants.eligibility: Consortium of at least two industry partners (one an SME) and one research organisation

grants.name: MVP Ventures Program
grants.amount: Stream 1 A$20k-50k (50% co-contribution); Stream 2 up to A$75k (25%) for women-owned, regional and First Nations businesses
grants.eligibility: NSW-based startups and SMEs with innovative products and IP rights

grants.name: Ignite Ideas Fund
grants.amount: Tier 1 up to A$100k; Tier 2 A$100k-200k
grants.eligibility: Queensland-headquartered innovative businesses with 50 or fewer FTE
grants.deadline: last: 2025-06-03; closed until next round announced

grants.name: Backing Female Founders: Female Founders Co-Investment Fund
grants.amount: A$50k-200k matched grant alongside new investment
grants.eligibility: QLD-headquartered, at least 51% women-owned and female-led, raised no more than A$500k

grants.name: Seed-Start Program
grants.agency: South Australia Department of State Development (Research and Innovation Fund)
grants.amount: Seed A$50k-100k (2:1 match); Start A$100k-500k (1:1 match)
grants.eligibility: SA-based (or relocating) innovative companies with turnover under A$1m in each of the last 3 years

grants.name: Innovation Booster Grant

grants.name: Business Innovation Program (BIP)

summary: Compact but internationally connected ecosystem centred on Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch, strong in SaaS, agritech, climate, fintech, space and deep tech. Notable outcomes include Xero, Rocket Lab, Vend and LanzaTech roots.

notes: As of 2026-10-20: Callaghan Innovation is being disestablished. Its grants (New to R&D, Career, Experience), RDTI and founder support now sit with MBIE Innovation Services. Callaghan's Technology Incubator Programme stays with Callaghan pending legislation to move it to a Public Research Organisation, so it is left out. The Ārohia Trailblazer and Evidence grants closed in Dec 2025. The Entrepreneur Work Visa is closed to new applicants.
